@ubiquity/software-development suspending ubiquibot (v1) now.
We just need the ability to set access control for labels.

![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/0040364a-a353-436f-80ad-6f411f827843)
This happened to me twice already once on desktop, once on mobile where I noticed that the font is incorrect because it was unable to load the Proxima Nova font file. 
When I checked the logs on desktop, it was because I was getting error 422 rate limited. I think we have too many assets and our Cloudflare rate limiting might be too strict. 
We can consider minifying the assets and serving them in production. For example, combining all the CSS into a single file should solve this particular problem. I'm sure we can handle this in the build settings.
We can consider doing the same for JavaScript.

The compiled files should be git ignored probably, but otherwise I think this looks mostly good! Debating on if we will actually merge this in because the original problem is due to something else. But we can certainly credit for the work.

This seems wrong. This should be done dynamically. 
Besides this looks like it will append on every build making the file length a problem eventually?

That is a good point to specify the order. 
Ideally if we resolved the conflicts (perhaps there is some automated tooling, like Chrome's Lighthouse that can solve for this?)
But practically speaking this might be the best solution then.
Does this clear the file contents on every build? It should so that the file length doesn't run forever.

I just checked on my computer now and it doesn't appear that the rate limiting is the problem now. The first time I noticed the font falling back to Helvetica, it was because I was rate limited to download the hosted Proxima Nova font. 
I'm not sure why the fonts are not displaying correctly now. 
Something is wrong with the font files suddenly.
```

```
